package importing

import (
 "archive/zip";"bytes";"context";"encoding/json";"fmt";"io";"os";"testing"
)

type oldErrorNode struct {Type string; Text string; Children []oldErrorNode}
func captureErrorShape(err error) oldErrorNode {
 node:=oldErrorNode{Type:fmt.Sprintf("%T",err),Text:err.Error()}
 if joined,ok:=err.(interface{Unwrap()[]error});ok {
  for _,child:=range joined.Unwrap(){node.Children=append(node.Children,captureErrorShape(child))}
 } else if wrapped,ok:=err.(interface{Unwrap()error});ok && wrapped.Unwrap()!=nil {
  node.Children=append(node.Children,captureErrorShape(wrapped.Unwrap()))
 }
 return node
}

func TestCaptureOldErrorShapes(t *testing.T) {
 cases:=make(map[string]oldErrorNode)
 _,_,err:=readASARHeader(bytes.NewReader(make([]byte,16)),100,DefaultArchiveLimits())
 cases["pickle lengths"]=captureErrorShape(err)
 _,err=decodeASARHeader([]byte("{"),100,DefaultArchiveLimits())
 cases["ASAR JSON"]=captureErrorShape(err)
 _,err=decodeASARHeader([]byte("{\"files\":{\"..\":{\"size\":1,\"offset\":\"0\"}}}"),100,DefaultArchiveLimits())
 cases["ASAR path"]=captureErrorShape(err)
 _,err=validateElectronZIPDirectory([]zipHeaderFacts{{Name:"../escape"}},DefaultArchiveLimits())
 cases["ZIP path"]=captureErrorShape(err)
 _,err=validateElectronZIPDirectory([]zipHeaderFacts{{Name:"a"},{Name:"a"}},DefaultArchiveLimits())
 cases["ZIP duplicate"]=captureErrorShape(err)
 _,err=validateElectronZIPDirectory([]zipHeaderFacts{{Name:"a",Flags:1}},DefaultArchiveLimits())
 cases["ZIP encrypted"]=captureErrorShape(err)
 _,err=validateElectronZIPDirectory([]zipHeaderFacts{{Name:"a",Method:99}},DefaultArchiveLimits())
 cases["ZIP method"]=captureErrorShape(err)
 _,err=validateElectronZIPDirectory([]zipHeaderFacts{{Name:"a",UncompressedSize64:9}},ArchiveLimits{MaxEntries:10,MaxEntryBytes:1})
 cases["ZIP limit"]=captureErrorShape(err)
 // The original resource monitor preserves the read cause, while its byte
 // limit dominates that same cause before accounting or prefix capture.
 monitor:=&archiveReadMonitor{ctx:context.Background(),reader:&captureFaultReader{},limit:10}
 _,err=monitor.Read(make([]byte,4))
 cases["member read"]=captureErrorShape(err)
 monitor=&archiveReadMonitor{ctx:context.Background(),reader:&captureFaultReader{},limit:1}
 _,err=monitor.Read(make([]byte,4))
 cases["member limit"]=captureErrorShape(err)
 _,err=ScanFlatZIP(context.Background(),oldCaptureZIP(t,"dir/",nil),DefaultArchiveLimits())
 cases["flat directory"]=captureErrorShape(err)
 _,err=ScanZIP(context.Background(),oldCaptureZIP(t,"data.bin",[]byte{'P','K',3,4}),DefaultArchiveLimits())
 cases["scan nested"]=captureErrorShape(err)
 body,err:=json.MarshalIndent(cases,"","  ")
 if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 if err:=os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("RETROM_OLD_ERROR_CAPTURE"),append(body,'\n'),0600);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
}
type captureFaultReader struct{}
func (*captureFaultReader)Read(buffer []byte)(int,error){return copy(buffer,[]byte("abc")),io.ErrUnexpectedEOF}

func oldCaptureZIP(t *testing.T,name string,body []byte)string{
 t.Helper()
 var contents bytes.Buffer
 writer:=zip.NewWriter(&contents)
 member,err:=writer.Create(name)
 if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 if len(body)>0 {if _,err:=member.Write(body);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}}
 if err:=writer.Close();err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 path:=t.TempDir()+"/fixture.zip"
 if err:=os.WriteFile(path,contents.Bytes(),0600);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 return path
}
